carpet.rule.reintroduceIllegalBlockEntit: Reintroduces illegal block entities removed in 1.21.1, so sound suppression works again
A block entity may stay under a block of another type again, and is no longer deleted when its chunk loads
Removed blocks send their neighbor updates before their block entity is deleted again, so update suppression can keep the block entity
An illegal sculk sensor block entity throws IllegalArgumentException when it hears a vibration (sound suppression)
Turn it on before loading chunks with old suppressors, and back up your world
carpet.rule.legacyThrowableMovement.name: legacyThrowableMovement
carpet.rule.legacyThrowableMovement.desc: Makes throwable projectiles move like in 1.21.1, for pearl cannons built before 1.21.2
carpet.rule.legacyThrowableMovement.extr: pearl: only ender pearls; all: also snowballs, eggs, thrown potions and bottles of enchanting
They move by their old velocity before drag and gravity are applied, and hit blocks and entities before moving
Arrows, tridents, fireballs and wind charges are not affected
carpet.rule.soundSuppressionRange.name: soundSuppressionRange
carpet.rule.soundSuppressionRange.desc: How far away sound suppressors (illegal sculk sensors) hear vibrations
0 is vanilla: 8 blocks for sculk sensors, 16 for calibrated sculk sensors
1 - 64 sets the radius of every sound suppressor; normal sculk sensors are not affected
